svg.text: URL occurrences per day — stacked bar, one segment per host, colored by host type

Sources: prowiki + apchem + wiki4d + ludism + milkwiki + texteditors + pastes + gems + popcat-wayback + per-site paste scrapes. Y-axis is log10; segment height = log(cum_top) − log(cum_bottom), so bottom-of-stack categories dominate visually.
